# Pharmacy Bill/Receipt Layout Analysis (Pixel-Perfect)

## 1. EXACT LAYOUT STRUCTURE (Top to Bottom)

### Header Section
- **Position**: Topmost horizontal band (0-15% of document height)
- **Content**: Pharmacy name in Devanagari script
- **Border**: Solid red line (1px) below header

### GST & Identification Section
- **Position**: Below header (15-20% of document height)
- **Content**: Address line + GST number
- **Border**: None

### Memo Type & Date Section
- **Position**: Below GST section (20-25% of document height)
- **Content**: "Cash Memo" button + "Date :" label
- **Border**: None

### Patient Information Section
- **Position**: Below memo type (25-30% of document height)
- **Content**: "Patient's Name & Add" label + blank line
- **Border**: Solid red line (1px) below

### Doctor Information Section
- **Position**: Below patient info (30-35% of document height)
- **Content**: "Doctor's Name & Add" label + blank line
- **Border**: Solid red line (1px) below

### Table Section
- **Position**: Below doctor info (35-90% of document height)
- **Content**: 7-column data table with multiple rows
- **Border**: Solid red lines (1px) for all cell boundaries

### Footer Section
- **Position**: Below table (90-100% of document height)
- **Content**: DL numbers, Hindi text, "Q.P.Sign" label, "Total" label
- **Border**: Solid red line (1px) above footer

## 2. Field Labels & Exact Text

### Header Text
- **Devanagari**: "श्रीकृष्ण औषधालय ३।।५ श्रीराम जनरल स्टोर्स"
- **Translation**: "Shri Krishna Pharmacy 3.5 Shri Ram General Stores"

### Address Line
- **Text**: "श्रीराम ३।।५ श्रीराम, अशोक रोड, गोरखपुर गो.मंडल (GST No. 27ABDPF4456H1ZR)"
- **Translation**: "Shri Ram 3.5 Shri Ram, Ashok Road, Gorakhpur Gor. Mandal (GST No. 27ABDPF4456H1ZR)"

### Memo Type
- **Text**: "Cash Memo" (white text on red background)

### Date Label
- **Text**: "Date :"

### Patient Field
- **Text**: "Patient's Name & Add"

### Doctor Field
- **Text**: "Doctor's Name & Add"

### Table Headers
- **Column 1**: "Particular's"
- **Column 2**: "Qty."
- **Column 3**: "Name of comp."
- **Column 4**: "B.No."
- **Column 5**: "Exp.Dt."
- **Column 6**: "Amount"
- **Column 7**: "Rs. Ps."

### Footer Text
- **DL Numbers**: "DL. No.:: 20-339158, 21-339159"
- **Hindi Text**: "मैं श्रीकृष्ण औषधालय का स्वामी श्रीराम प्रसाद गुप्ता हूँ।"
- **Translation**: "I am Shri Ram Prasad Gupta, owner of Shri Krishna Pharmacy."
- **Signature Label**: "Q.P.Sign"
- **Total Label**: "Total"

## 3. Table Structure

### Column Configuration
| Column | Width | Alignment | Header Text | Description |
|--------|-------|-----------|-------------|-------------|
| 1      | 35%   | Left      | Particular's | Item description |
| 2      | 10%   | Center    | Qty.        | Quantity |
| 3      | 20%   | Left      | Name of comp.| Company name |
| 4      | 10%   | Center    | B.No.       | Batch number |
| 5      | 10%   | Center    | Exp.Dt.     | Expiry date |
| 6      | 8%    | Right     | Amount      | Amount in Rupees |
| 7      | 7%    | Right     | Rs. Ps.     | Rupees and Paise |

### Row Configuration
- **Total Rows**: 10 (including header row)
- **Data Rows**: 9 (rows 2-10)
- **Cell Content**: All cells are blank (no data filled)

## 4. Post-Table Elements

### Footer Section
- **DL Numbers**: Left-aligned
- **Hindi Text**: Left-aligned
- **Signature Label**: Center-aligned
- **Total Label**: Right-aligned
- **Total Amount Field**: Right-aligned (blank)

## 5. Border Styles

- **Header Border**: Solid red line (1px)
- **Patient Info Border**: Solid red line (1px)
- **Doctor Info Border**: Solid red line (1px)
- **Table Borders**: All cell boundaries - solid red lines (1px)
- **Footer Border**: Solid red line (1px) above footer

## 6. Font Styles

- **Header Text**: Bold, larger font size (Devanagari script)
- **Address/GST Text**: Regular font size
- **Memo Type**: Bold, white text on red background
- **Field Labels**: Regular font size
- **Table Headers**: Bold, regular font size
- **Table Data**: Regular font size
- **Footer Text**: Regular font size
- **Total Label**: Bold font

## 7. Color Scheme

- **Background Color**: Light pink/magenta
- **Text Color**: Dark red/maroon
- **Header Background**: Transparent
- **Memo Type Background**: Red
- **Memo Type Text**: White
- **Borders**: Red
- **Table Headers**: Dark red text on light pink background

## 8. Special Elements

- **QR Code**: None visible
- **Logo**: None visible
- **Special Symbols**: 
  - Devanagari script characters
  - "।।।" (three vertical dots) in header
  - ":" (colon) in various labels
  - "." (period) in batch number and expiry date headers
- **Decorative Elements**: None

## 9. Hindi Text (Devanagari & Transliteration)

### Header
- **Devanagari**: "श्रीकृष्ण औषधालय ३।।५ श्रीराम जनरल स्टोर्स"
- **Transliteration**: "Shri Krishna Aushadhalya 3.5 Shri Ram Janral Stores"

### Address Line
- **Devanagari**: "श्रीराम ३।।५ श्रीराम, अशोक रोड, गोरखपुर गो.मंडल"
- **Transliteration**: "Shri Ram 3.5 Shri Ram, Ashok Road, Gorakhpur Go.Mandal"

### Footer
- **Devanagari**: "मैं श्रीकृष्ण औषधालय का स्वामी श्रीराम प्रसाद गुप्ता हूँ।"
- **Transliteration**: "Main Shri Krishna Aushadhalya ka swami Shri Ram Prasad Gupta hoon."
